title: Monday blues on a Friday
author: Vandana Kumar
text:
There is a gentle stream outside
No currents
No whirlpool
Nothing will rock your boat tonight
Does that comfort you?

Sail along
Feel your heartbeat
Somewhere else
Inside a lover`s safe place
But you need a lover to love, for that

;

Everyone smiles
The same way
It hurts
How they all hide the same aches

Even if it matches the shades of the skies
Find a little storm somewhere
Find turbulent weather
To cure you
